headline: 埃玛·沃姆斯利不再竞选连任微软公司董事
summary: 微软公司11月5日向证券交易委员会提交8-K（第5.02项）：董事沃姆斯利11月4日通知公司，不在2026年年度股东大会上竞选连任，任职至该次股东大会。股东大会日期申报未写，effective_at 留空。其他现职、新任命未查清。

sources.title: Microsoft Corporation Form 8-K (November 5, 2026)
sources.excerpt: On November 4, 2026, Emma N. Walmsley, a member of the Board of Directors of Microsoft Corporation (the “Company”) since 2019, informed the Company of her decision not to stand for re-election at the Company’s 2026 annual shareholder meeting (the “Annual Meeting”).
